population: 65 original unseen cases, excluding pilot positions 7,29,40,58,70. No substitutions, adaptive selection or pilot pooling.

generation.request_policy: Original allowlisted payloads byte-for-byte under canonical JSON; no new messages, no reference targets or evaluation anchors in model input.

primary.answer_score: Arithmetic mean of two independent ordinal ratings, divided by 2
primary.confirmation_rule: All 65 cases have complete generation and both reviews for all four conditions, and the primary paired-case 95% bootstrap interval lower endpoint is greater than zero.

secondary: Character F1 using the unchanged official scorer
Writer simple effects, dialogue simple and marginal effects, and interaction for each metric
Per-condition score means and fully correct counts
Strict ranking reversals and ordinal inter-reviewer agreement

statistics.interval: Two-sided percentile 95%; sorted bootstrap means at zero-based indices floor(0.025*B) and floor(0.975*B), matching the existing analyzer
statistics.resampling: Resample case indices; retain all four paired conditions and both review scores within a selected case
statistics.secondary_inference: Descriptive estimates and intervals only; no unadjusted confirmatory claims or claim of guaranteed power
statistics.ranking_reversals: Opposite nonzero signs of F1 and semantic differences; tolerance 1e-12; report ties separately

rubric.scoring_changes: None. Existing ordinal axes, evidence rules and mean-of-two aggregation are unchanged.
rubric.scope_clarification: The rubric file retains pilot-specific counts and descriptive-only wording as historical metadata. This protocol explicitly replaces those operational clauses with 65 cases, 260 answers, the frozen review batches, and the predefined primary bootstrap analysis; no scoring thresholds change.

reference_policy.source: Pinned original targets and surfaces; outcome-blind anchors in anchors.json
reference_policy.canonical_truth: The fictional reference solution determines semantic correctness, including speculative/supernatural mechanisms. It does not establish real-world scientific or medical truth.
reference_policy.quality_flags: Reference inconsistencies are flagged before generation. All 65 remain in the primary analysis; no outcome-driven exclusions or repairs. Report flag-specific descriptive results as a prespecified sensitivity summary.
reference_policy.sufficient_alternatives: When anchors explicitly use OR, either specified mechanism suffices. Otherwise all required components are needed for score 2.

blind_review.assignment: Deterministic independent case orders, seeds 62101 and 62102; opaque item IDs and within-batch answer order frozen before generation
blind_review.reviewers: Two independent fresh-context model reviewers per batch using the available Work environment; no paid external API. Each reviewer may access only the unchanged rubric, review_protocol.json and its assigned packet. Separate fresh contexts for the two streams; no shared prior evaluations or communication.
allowed: exact recorded questions and referee replies
blind_review.record: Ordinal scores, concise evidence-linked annotation, exact cited answer span and Hxx references. No internal reasoning transcripts. Preserve both original annotation files privately; publish numerical results and necessary evidence excerpts.
blind_review.disagreement: Retain both scores; primary aggregation is their mean. No replacement by consensus. Any later adjudication is separately labelled and secondary.
blind_review.limitations: Same-family model reviewers may share bias. Procedural blinding is not filesystem isolation; recognizable case content may remain.

failure_policy.generation: Stop on the first startup, tokenizer, inference, malformed-response or budget error. No automatic retry, resume, requeue or extra GPU job. Preserve every started/result record, including ambiguous calls.
failure_policy.warnings: Warnings alone do not constitute failure. Require process exit, failed readiness/deadline, failed invariant, HTTP or completion error.
failure_policy.truncation: Retain and score length-capped outputs; report counts and limitations, never regenerate them.
failure_policy.missing: Report all failures and missing review cells. No imputation or replacement. Complete-case estimates may be descriptive; withhold the primary confirmatory conclusion if any required generation/review is missing.

change_control: Freeze rubric, anchors, assignments, request selection, budget and executable code before generation. Amendments require a new version and documented reason before any new output is inspected. No GPU submission before explicit authorization. A changed freeze invalidates an authorization for the earlier freeze.
publication: English research methods, aggregate/per-case numerical results, necessary evidence excerpts, hashes and reproducible code only. Raw operational logs, authorization records, browser state and reviewer working records remain in private run storage. Preserve original records; do not publish internal reasoning transcripts. No upstream changes, PR merge or unapproved history rewrite.
